items.title: Anthropic Frontend Design
items.claim: The skill instructs a contextual visual plan and critique of generic defaults; this is an author-published workflow, not a pool result test.

items.title: Vercel Web Design Guidelines
items.claim: Version 1.0.0 fetches current guidelines and reports file-and-line findings; the fetched rules are a mutable dependency.

items.title: Vercel React Best Practices
items.claim: Version 1.0.0 states a React and Next.js scope and 70 rules across eight performance categories.

items.title: Vercel Web Interface Guidelines
items.claim: Vercel publishes the guideline source and its documented review-skill installation command.

items.title: Vercel React Composition Patterns
items.claim: Version 1.0.0 targets flag-heavy React APIs, compound components, lifted state, and component architecture; this describes an author-published workflow, not a pool result test.

items.title: Vercel React View Transitions
items.claim: Version 1.0.0 targets React and Next.js interface transitions and requires reduced-motion and runtime checks; this is an author-published workflow, not a pool result test.

items.title: Vercel Agent Skills 063bee94 release
items.claim: The current Vercel Agent Skills discovery release is tagged to commit 063bee94, providing an immutable source pin for the two new listings.

items.title: React ViewTransition reference
items.claim: React documents ViewTransition activation through Transition, Suspense, or useDeferredValue and identifies relevant component caveats.

items.title: Vercel Agent Skills issue #286
items.claim: The issue reports an incorrect lifted-state example and consistency problems in Composition Patterns; this pool did not reproduce the report.

items.title: Vercel Agent Skills pull request #304
items.claim: An open proposed correction addresses the reported Composition Patterns example; it is not an accepted release change.

items.title: r/codex UI skill workflow question
items.claim: A community question asks whether UI skills conflict and how to avoid generic output; it is audience language, not a performance comparison.

items.title: r/codex Motion UI Skill showcase
items.claim: An author offers a side-by-side motion-skill demo and Codex installation path; it is not independent outcome evidence.
